headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 19, 2026, the portfolio is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 24.45% compared to SPY's 13.61%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 10.84%, indicating that the portfolio is not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a significant return of 45.66%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 11.33%, highlighting a disparity in performance among the portfolios. This relative strength against SPY is particularly noteworthy during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience in the portfolio's strategy. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
